stem: [洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及方法]一家国际银行正在调查其一家代理行提出的一笔付款请求,该请求在自动交易监控系统中触发了警报.这笔付款的发起方是一家位于香港的公司,最终收款人是一位位于纽约的个人.银行应首先采取哪些步骤来处理该警报？(选择三项.)

options.A: 向该公司在香港的银行发出314(b)请求
options.B: 与收款人联系以核实身份证明文件
options.C: 确认收款人和发起人均非受制裁方
options.D: 要求提供相关证明文件,包括发票和合同,以确认付款用途
options.E: 通过公开来源核查汇款人和收款人的负面媒体信息

stem_en: An international bank is investigating a payment requested by one of its correspondent relationships that generated an alert in the automated transaction monitoring system. The payment originated from a corporation located in Hong Kong and the final beneficiary is an individual located in New York. Which steps should the bank take first to address the alert? (Select three.)

options_en.A: Send a 314(b) request to the corporation's bank in Hong Kong.
options_en.B: Call the receiving individual to review identity verification documents.
options_en.C: Confirm that neither the beneficiary nor the originator are sanctioned parties.
options_en.D: Request relevant supporting documentation, including invoices and contracts, to confirm the purpose of the payment.
options_en.E: Check adverse media on the sender and recipient through public sources.
